resources.string: Hide the lock screen fingerprint icon and its hints. Fingerprint unlock stays available.
Use transparent PNG or SVG artwork, or leave the icon hidden.
Could not import the image. Choose a PNG under 8 MB and 8192 × 8192 pixels, or an SVG under 1.1 MB, and check that the module is active.

Enable System UI and Biometrics (com.samsung.android.biometrics.app.setting) in this module’s LSPosed scope, then reboot once. Custom artwork uses one small Biometrics hook; parsing happens off the UI thread. 100% uses the stock icon size.
